title: How to use Duration Block power
summary: Clear Duration Blocks at the moment their timed power helps most, and queue the supported moves right after.

seo.title: Use Block Out Duration Block Power Well
seo.description: Time Block Out Duration Block clears so the temporary power supports the hardest moves and is not wasted on easy ones.

question: When should I clear Duration Blocks to get the most from their power?

sections.heading: Clear on cue, not on sight
body: The power is temporary, so clear the Duration Block when the next moves actually need it.
Clearing too early wastes the effect before the hard part arrives.

sections.heading: Queue the supported moves
body: Decide the moves the power will support before you clear the block.
Execute them immediately after the clear while the power is active.

sections.heading: Do not waste it on easy moves
body: If you could finish a section without the power, save the clear for a tighter spot.
Match the power to the bottleneck it removes.
